evidence.excerpt: Official current Lunch & Dinner and Breakfast menu surface; item descriptions and category navigation are accessible.
Official homepage identifies Beteseb Restaurant and Silver Spring address.

Official about/menu page identifies 8201 Georgia Ave and states meals are served with injera made of either wheat or teff; imported teff injera is described as gluten-free. This is not item-complete allergen disclosure.
Official online-ordering surface names the Silver Spring pickup address and exposes Vegan & Vegetarian, Beef & Chicken, House Special, Half & Half Combo, and Breakfast sections.
